_doc: Hand-curated half of the licence inventory (#805): what each top-level directory IS and which licence applies to it today, per-asset overrides, and Maven group licences that need no POM lookup. 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-android-licence-inventory.py refresh merges this with registry-resolved licences into licenses/inventory.json; check fails when the tree has a subject neither covers. LicenseRef-NoLicenseGranted = no licence file applies: all rights reserved by default. `proposed` is a proposal only - nothing is relicensed. Not legal advice.

com.google.mlkit.note: proprietary binary SDK under the ML Kit Terms of Service - not GPL-compatible if linked into a GPL app

com.google.ar.note: proprietary; Google APIs ToS + ARCore Additional Terms (see ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md)

com.diegonmarcos.fleet.note: own code: the fleet-ui included build (ab_cloud-libs-shared/web), not a published dependency

_dotfiles.what: repo dotfile declarations (_dotfiles convention, #1290): apps/ = app index / launch scripts and editor/agent configs, git/ = git config (gitignore, attributes, hooks)

0_hub.what: git submodule pointer to the cloudy-___ hub repo (its own licence applies inside)

a0_docs.proposed: PROPOSED (owner decides): CC-BY-NC-4.0 for prose, or keep all rights reserved

a_solutions.what: own Android tooling (termux-boot replacement, hooking engines, data exporter...) - README in ae-tool_termux-boot states it is not a termux-boot fork

aa_cloud-superapp.what: Cloud SuperApp launcher; links shared libs incl. GPL-3.0 libs:keyboard/libs:gitsync - see LICENSING.md conflicts

ab_cloud-libs-shared.what: shared libraries (libs/*), lib-apks and keyboard-engines; the upstream-derived libs are listed in licenses/upstreams.json and keep their upstream licence
ab_cloud-libs-shared.exceptions: libs/keyboard GPL-3.0-only; libs/gitsync GPL-3.0; libs/firewall/firestack MPL-2.0; libs/net, libs/net-wg, libs/cropper, libs/gesture, libs/panoramaviewer Apache-2.0; libs/calc native build pulls GPL-2.0-or-later libqalculate (see ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md); libs/contacts SocialImport.kt is own code (clean-room rewrite #828, replacing a Fossify Contacts GPL-3.0 port)

ac_cloud-account.what: Cloud Account app (#867, the Account page split out of cloud-superapp)

ac_cloud-media-center.what: Tauri 2 Android media hub (Rust + static web)

ac_cloud-calc.what: Cloud Calc app; its engine APK (libs/calc) statically links GPL-2.0-or-later libqalculate and ships as GPL-3.0-or-later per ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md

ac_cloud-contacts.what: Cloud Contacts app (README: native, not a fork)

ac_cloud-keyboard.what: Cloud Keyboard app module; compiles libs/keyboard (HeliBoard-derived, GPL-3.0-only) so the APK is GPL-3.0-only

ac_cloud-myterminal.what: hub APK (own) + patch series for Amaze File Manager/Utilities (GPL-3.0) and Acode (MIT) in forks/; the patches carry their upstream licence

ac_cloud-notes.what: AFFiNE fork (MIT part; Enterprise dirs pruned and guarded by licence-guard.yml)

ac_cloud-office.what: Collabora Online patch series + own build engine; patches MPL-2.0, engine scripts own

ac_cloud-search.what: Cloud Search app; data-source terms in ac_cloud-search/NOTICE.md

ac_cloud-store.what: Cloud Store app (#865, the Store split out of cloud-superapp)

ac_cloud-kg-store.what: Cloud KG Store app (knowledge-graph store and browser: fleet API, MCP and code-graph services, installed apps index, web sources of Cloud Search)

ad_CG-Omniverse.what: CG-Omniverse app (Galaxy, Game Store, VR Store pages behind Cloud > Lnktree)

ad_Capital-Stack-FinTerminal.what: Capital-Stack-FinTerminal app (FI | EQ | EX | NW | PM | MY-PM terminal pages behind Cloud > Lnktree)

ad_Hardtech-CAD.what: Hardtech-CAD app (MCAD, BIM, SolidWorks pages behind Cloud > Lnktree)

ad_Hardtech-Sim2Real.what: Hardtech-Sim2Real app (SAP2000, MATLAB, Ansys pages behind Cloud > Lnktree)

ac_cloud-superintel.what: Cloud SuperIntel app (Gemini-style AI chat over the fleet agent gateway)

ac_cloud-tools-small-llms.what: Cloud Tools Small LLMs app (small-model text tools over OpenRouter)

licenses.proposed: PROPOSED (owner decides): CC0-1.0 for the data

ac_cloud-notes/packages/common/theme.what: Design tokens vendored as build output from a Mozilla Public License 2.0 package; files stay MPL-2.0, see its LICENSE (#1098)

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cgc-3d/src/mai.what: libs:cgc-3d's vendored 3D code (#1373): three.js r185 examples (GLTFLoader, FBXLoader, GLTFExporter, SkeletonUtils, BufferGeometryUtils, NURBS, RoomEnvironment), three.js's copies of the meshoptimizer decoder and fflate, and @pixiv/three-vrm 3.5.5, bundled offline in the APK assets of the CG apps; see its LICENSE. The clips beside it (cgc/clips.json) are authored in-repo and released CC0-1.0.

ac_cloud-calc/data/assets/worldmap.what: Cloud Calc World Clock data (#1423): Natural Earth 1:110m land (public domain) drawn by the World clock map, and the city catalogue derived from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0, attributed in its LICENSE and ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md), both generated by ac_cloud-calc/data/gen/worldclock.py

ac_cloud-calc/data/assets/latex/katex.what: KaTeX 0.19.1 (Khan Academy and contributors), the TeX math renderer of Cloud Calc's LaTeX page: katex.min.js, auto-render.min.js and a trimmed katex.min.css, bundled offline in the APK assets (build.json::latex.renderer); see its LICENSE and ac_cloud-calc/NOTICE.md (#1329)

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cad-mesh/src/m.what: three.js r185 OBJLoader (examples/jsm/loaders), the OBJ reader of libs:cad-mesh, Hardtech-CAD's MCAD viewer (#1404); see its LICENSE.

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cad-brep/src/m.what: occt-import-js 0.0.23 (Viktor Kovacs) with Open CASCADE Technology compiled to WASM (LGPL-2.1 with the OCCT exception), the STEP/IGES reader of libs:cad-brep (#1404). Shipped unmodified as separate files (occt-import-js.js, occt-import-js.wasm), loaded at run time, so it can be replaced; see license.occt-import-js.txt and license.occt.txt.

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cad-dxf/src/ma.what: dxf-parser 1.1.2 (gdsestimating), the DXF reader of libs:cad-dxf (#1404); see its LICENSE.

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cad-3dm/src/ma.what: rhino3dm.js 8.35.0 (Robert McNeel & Associates), the Rhino 3DM reader of libs:cad-3dm (#1404), JS module + WASM; see its LICENSE.

ab_cloud-libs-shared/libs/cad-ifc/src/ma.what: web-ifc 0.0.78 (ThatOpen Company), the IFC reader of libs:cad-ifc (#1404), IIFE build + WASM, unmodified; files stay MPL-2.0, see LICENSE.md.
